title: platform: two lines still misstate the minimal preset and seed replace mode (platform-capabilities.ts L348 TSDoc; platform SKILL.md Seed Data "replace ⚠️ data loss")
body:
domain:skills#3 · huangyiirene · session_01J8VVAj7CvjkGXvgXzd6RZ7

## What is wrong

PR #31377 (#31299) corrected the platform skill's seed `mode` default and its `--preset minimal` sentence. Its contract review (6717563682) found two more lines outside that card's claim. Read on `main`:

1. **`packages/spec/src/kernel/platform-capabilities.ts` ≈L348 TSDoc:** "`--preset minimal` opts out entirely". It is right about the slate list, but incomplete. `NEEDS_JOB_AND_QUEUE` (`packages/core/src/capability-composition.ts`, via `resolveServedCapabilities`) puts `job` and `queue` back under minimal when `email`, `approvals` or `auth` is present, and `email` comes back with `auth`. Platform SKILL.md L296 says so after #31377.
2. **`skills/objectstack-platform/SKILL.md` § Seed Data:** marks `replace` "⚠️ data loss". The `SeedMode` code comment (`packages/spec/src/data/seed.zod.ts`) and the platform `seeds.md` reference say `replace` deletes nothing. One of the two is wrong. Read the seed loader's `replace` path and teach what it does. The section is registered exhaustive over `SeedMode` in `scripts/check-skill-identifier-liveness.mjs` (entry `seed-modes`), so keep every mode named.

## Suggested shape

Item 2 first: measure the loader, then fix whichever text is wrong (`'@objectstack/skills': patch` if the skill moves; the platform SKILL.md row is priced by the token ratchet). Item 1 is a comment-only spec edit that can ride the same PR.
